issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Stock.add(String): The UML in the problem statement (problem_statement.md) declares Stock.add(String) as returning void, while both the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java in the template repository) and the reference solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java in the solution repository) implement Stock.add(String) with return type int. This contradiction can confuse students about the expected signature and whether callers should use the returned integer value (current quantity) or not.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and the code consistent. The simplest fix is to update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare add(String): int to match the template and solution implementations (which return the updated quantity). Alternatively, change the template/solution method signature to void and update all call sites/tests to not rely on a returned int; however, this is more invasive since both repositories already use int.
